issues.detail: No health check is configured; the core's default URL is used
Mobile memory profile: QUIC receive windows capped, group health checks lazy every 600 s unless the model sets an interval
No DNS servers given; the tunnel resolves through 2 default public resolvers, queried through the proxy

1 server address(es) are domains: their addresses are not known before the tunnel starts and cannot be excluded from it; the system is expected to keep the extension's own connections out of its tunnel
1 server(s) are named by a domain: their names are resolved directly (proxy-server-nameserver), not through the tunnel
Address rules see one destination address: inside the tunnel the connection's own address (also when the domain is known from the resolver), otherwise the first resolved address
Domain rules match connections whose address came from the tunnel's resolver (DNS mapping) or that name a domain; sniffing is off
